name: Ōsato (Miyagi, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōsato town emblem in white: a ring enclosing stylised characters, with a crown-like point at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Ōsato, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 3 November 1970; the emblem dates from 24 April 1967.

features.role: Ōsato town emblem — a ring enclosing stylised characters, with a crown-like point at the top
